title: Settlement Table: Guest-Service-Fee Refund Where Rewards Credits Paid Part of a Stay
content:
# Settlement table — guest-service-fee refund on a stay partly paid with Roamhaven Rewards credits

**Rule.** When Roamhaven Rewards credits paid part of a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, the credit-funded part of the guest-service-fee refund goes back as credits and only the rest is paid to the card: when credits were redeemed on the stay and none of them has been reinstated yet, the card receives the guest-service-fee refund times one minus the credits redeemed divided by the stay's total price; when credits were redeemed on the stay and part of them has already been reinstated, the card receives it times one minus the credits still outstanding (redeemed less reinstated) divided by the stay's total price; in every other case, including when no credits were redeemed, the card receives the whole guest-service-fee refund. The credit-funded part is taken out after the fee percentage is applied, and the result is rounded half up to the cent once.

Credits redeemed and reinstated are read from the stay's entries in the guest's Roamhaven Rewards ledger; the total price is the one recorded on the stay.

| Credits on the stay (hypothetical, total price 3,000.00) | Card share of the refund | Fee refund of 120.00 before the split, card part |
|---|---|---|
| 600.00 redeemed, none reinstated | one minus 0.20, that is 0.80 | 96.00 |
| 600.00 redeemed, 300.00 reinstated | one minus 0.10, that is 0.90 | 108.00 |
| 600.00 redeemed, 600.00 reinstated | whole refund | 120.00 |
| none redeemed | whole refund | 120.00 |
